high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "irasoles," which appears to be a sponsored post. The post features a pair of brown leather sandals with intricate braided details on the straps. The sandals are placed on a rustic wooden surface that has a weathered appearance, giving it a vintage look. To the left of the sandals, there is a small bouquet of dried flowers, adding a decorative touch to the composition. The text in the post reads: "Earthen Clay Faux Leather Kolhapuri Sparkling bright Ira Soles' Faux Leather Kolhapuri..." indicating that these are Kolhapuri sandals
